column1: # FEDENA, verbatim from projectfedena/fedena NOTICE: "Fedena / Copyright 2011 Foradian Technologies
# Private Limited. ... Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License")".
# T212 - the Fedena question is SETTLED and should not be re-searched. The grant is real: a licensor
# statement in NOTICE, which is the strongest channel available here. But there is NO licence body in
# either tree, and the newest of the two trees has not moved in over ten years. So the web's one
# Apache-2.0 SIS answer is an abandoned 2011 Rails application, and the hole does NOT close.
# WHAT CHANGES ANYWAY: two ACTIVE copyleft SIS options are now verified and dated, which this KB did
# not hold. For a client who can accept GPL-2.0, RosarioSIS (HEAD 1 day old) and openSIS-Classic
# (HEAD 8 days old) are live routes. The absence is now specifically "no PERMISSIVE and MAINTAINED
# SIS", which is a narrower and more useful statement than "no permissive SIS".
